plateHintSelect.en: Tap wells to select them. Long-press a second well to take the whole block in between; tap a row letter or column number for the whole row or column.
plateHintSelect.zh: 点击孔位即可选中；长按另一个孔位可选中两者之间的整块区域；点击行字母或列号可选中整行或整列。

plateLegendEmpty.en: Nothing labelled yet — name the selected wells, or apply a template.
plateLegendEmpty.zh: 尚未标记——为选中的孔位命名，或应用一个模板。

plateClearConfirm.en: Clear every labelled well on this plate?
plateClearConfirm.zh: 清空本板所有已标记的孔位？

plateTypeConfirm.en: Switching the plate type clears the current layout.
plateTypeConfirm.zh: 切换板型会清空当前布局。

plateTplDescSerial.en: Each step divides the concentration by the dilution factor — one step per column (→ Row) or per row (↓ Column).
plateTplDescSerial.zh: 每一步将浓度除以稀释倍数——沿行方向每列一个梯度，或沿列方向每行一个梯度。

plateTplDescDose.en: One block of rows per drug, diluted across the columns. Replicates set how many rows each drug gets.
plateTplDescDose.zh: 每种药物占一组行，沿列方向梯度稀释；重复数决定每种药物占几行。

plateTplDescCheckerboard.en: Alternates two labels across the plate; replicates set the size of each block.
plateTplDescCheckerboard.zh: 两种标签在整板上交替排列；重复数决定每个方块的大小。

plateTplDescControl.en: Places positive controls (top half of last column), negative controls (bottom half of last column), and blanks (first column).
plateTplDescControl.zh: 在最后一列上半部分放置阳性对照，下半部分放置阴性对照，第一列放置空白。

plateTplDescAntibody.en: One row per antibody, diluted across the columns from the starting concentration.
plateTplDescAntibody.zh: 每个抗体占一行，从起始浓度沿列方向梯度稀释。

plateTplReplaces.en: Applying a template replaces the current layout.
plateTplReplaces.zh: 应用模板会替换当前布局。

plateSendHint.en: Files are sent to a chat — pick File Transfer to keep them.
plateSendHint.zh: 文件会发送到聊天——选择「文件传输助手」即可保存。

plateCopiedInstead.en: Can't send files here — contents copied
plateCopiedInstead.zh: 当前无法发送文件，已复制内容

readerNoDataDesc.en: Paste values or load a file — the detected plate appears here as a heatmap, with a tidy long-format table below.
readerNoDataDesc.zh: 粘贴数据或选择文件后，这里会显示识别出的孔板热图，下方生成长格式（tidy）数据表。

readerRingHint.en: Ring colour = sample label from the designer
readerRingHint.zh: 外圈颜色 = 设计器中的样品标签

readerHintNoLayout.en: Label wells in the Designer first — sample labels are merged here and summarised per sample as n, mean, SD and CV%.
readerHintNoLayout.zh: 先在「布板设计」中标记孔位——样品标签会合并到这里，并按样品汇总 n、均值、标准差和变异系数。

readerHintMismatch.en: The plate sizes differ, so there is nothing to summarise by sample.
readerHintMismatch.zh: 孔板尺寸不一致，无法按样品汇总。

readerHintMergeOff.en: Turn on “Merge sample labels from designer” to summarise by sample.
readerHintMergeOff.zh: 勾选「合并设计器中的样品标签」即可按样品汇总。

readerHintNoValues.en: None of the labelled wells have values in this data.
readerHintNoValues.zh: 已标记的孔位在这组数据中没有数值。

readerBigFile.en: Large file — only the beginning is shown here; all of it is parsed.
readerBigFile.zh: 文件较大——此处仅显示开头部分，全部内容均已解析。

readerMoreRows.en: more rows in the exported CSV
readerMoreRows.zh: 行未显示，已包含在导出的 CSV 中
